evidence.note: Driver-side door is closed before the first manipulation.
Hand pulls the exterior handle and the door begins opening.
Door is clearly open.
Door remains open at the end of the inspection.
Door is closed again.
Driver-side door is closed before the second manipulation.
Hand operates the handle to open the door again.
Door is visibly open.
Door remains fully open.
Hand pushes the door toward the body.
Door is closed.
Front hood is fully closed.
Hand reaches under the hood edge to lift it.
Hood is partway raised.
Hood is fully open, exposing the engine bay.
Hand begins lowering the open hood.
Hood is visibly descending toward the latch.
Hood is fully closed.
Rear hatch is fully closed.
Hand reaches beneath the rear hatch/spoiler edge.
Rear hatch is being lifted.
Hatch is open and the cargo compartment is exposed.
Hatch remains open immediately before closing.
Hand lowers the hatch toward the body.
Rear hatch is fully closed.

notes: Open is treated as the on state and closed as the off state. Four distinct interaction episodes are visible; the same driver-side door is deliberately opened and closed twice, with a clear closed interval between the cycles.
scene_description: A user circles a parked blue Toyota Supra, inspecting it and manipulating the driver-side door twice, then the front hood, and finally the rear cargo hatch.
